name: checklist
description: To-do lists for your ticket. Each section shows the list named in its "List" option; add tasks and tick them off from the list's own page (the "Edit tasks" link in the editor). Done tasks print crossed out on the next ticket and then go away. Nothing prints when no task is pending.
author: eipporko

inspector_template.label: List (sections with the same name share their tasks)
